name: IT's for Adults
source: Kami is sexy. Kami is horny. But Kami is ever so bored. That is, until she finds out that her adventurous and outgoing freaky best friend Chloe has arranged a special surprise for her. It’s time for Kami to have the sort of sex she only ever hears about from her BFF. It’s her turn to be a freak in the sheets!
translation: 卡米性感迷人，卡米欲火焚身，可卡米却无聊透顶——直到她发现，自己那位热爱冒险、性格奔放又玩得极野的闺蜜克洛伊，竟为她安排了一份特别的惊喜。是时候让卡米亲自体验一番平日里只听闺蜜提起过的火辣欢愉了——这回，轮到她在床笫之间彻底放飞自我！
